payload.gloss: the set of notes: ideas, questions and decisions not yet canonical, the intake that design canonizes. Anyone may capture, revise or retract a note. A note's title is its name, one live note per title, and its kind is a label the runtime never interprets. A live note that blocks a plan or unit is an **owed ruling**; it blocks what it names until it no longer does, by being retracted or revised to block nothing, and a diverged note blocks whatever any of its heads blocks until it is reconciled.
